unit: 중1 L7 외부지문 — Two Different Jobs
sentences: At a restaurant, Jane and Maria talked about their jobs.
They agreed that there are a few similarities.
For both pilots and artists, there is a lot of competition and there are few famous women.
In both jobs, you have to be very strong and sure of yourself.
Of course, there are also many differences between the two jobs.
Pilots and artists have to be strong in different ways.
Pilots have to stay awake for long hours, and sometimes they have to make important decisions quickly.
Artists, however, have to be strong in their ideas about art and life.
People in the two jobs also work in different ways.
Pilots usually work with other people, but artists usually work alone.
Finally, there is an important difference in lifestyle.
Pilots travel for their job and are often away from home.
Artists, however, work at home or in a studio near home.
Also, unlike pilots, artists can start and stop working when they want.
Maria said she could never be a pilot because she hates airplanes.
Jane said she could never be an artist because she hates working alone.
There are many things to think about when choosing a job, but what you enjoy should come first.

items.statement_ko: Jane과 Maria는 식당에서 자신들의 직업에 대해 이야기했다.
items.why_ko: 1번 문장에 식당에서 두 사람이 직업에 대해 이야기했다고 나온다.
_evidence_text: At a restaurant, Jane and Maria talked about their jobs.
items.statement_en: Jane and Maria had a talk about their jobs while they were at a restaurant.

items.statement_ko: 두 사람은 두 직업 사이에 공통점이 전혀 없다는 데 동의했다.
items.why_ko: 몇 가지 공통점이 있다는 데 동의했다고 했다.
_evidence_text: They agreed that there are a few similarities.
items.statement_en: The two women agreed that the two jobs share nothing in common at all.

items.statement_ko: 조종사와 예술가 모두 경쟁이 심하고 유명한 여성은 적다.
items.why_ko: 3번 문장에 경쟁이 많고 유명한 여성이 적다고 했다.
_evidence_text: For both pilots and artists, there is a lot of competition and there are few famous women.
items.statement_en: Both pilots and artists face strong competition, and not many women in these jobs are famous.

items.statement_ko: 두 직업 모두 강해야 하지만 자신에 대한 확신은 필요하지 않다.
items.why_ko: 매우 강하고 자신에 대한 확신도 있어야 한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: In both jobs, you have to be very strong and sure of yourself.
items.statement_en: People in both jobs need to be strong, but they do not need to be sure of themselves.

items.statement_ko: 두 직업 사이에는 차이점도 많이 있다.
_evidence_text: Of course, there are also many differences between the two jobs.
items.statement_en: The two jobs also have a lot of differences.

items.statement_ko: 조종사와 예술가는 서로 다른 방식으로 강해야 한다.
items.why_ko: 6번 문장에 다른 방식으로 강해야 한다고 나온다.
_evidence_text: Pilots and artists have to be strong in different ways.
items.statement_en: Pilots and artists need to be strong in ways that are not the same.

items.statement_ko: 조종사는 오랜 시간 깨어 있어야 하고, 때로는 중요한 결정을 빨리 내려야 한다.
_evidence_text: Pilots have to stay awake for long hours, and sometimes they have to make important decisions quickly.
items.statement_en: Pilots need to keep their eyes open for many hours, and they sometimes must decide important things fast.

items.statement_ko: 예술가는 무엇보다 몸이 튼튼해야 한다고 했다.
items.why_ko: 예술가는 예술과 삶에 대한 생각에서 강해야 한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Artists, however, have to be strong in their ideas about art and life.
items.statement_en: The passage says that artists most of all need strong, healthy bodies.

items.statement_ko: 두 직업의 사람들은 일하는 방식도 서로 다르다.
_evidence_text: People in the two jobs also work in different ways.
items.statement_en: People in these two jobs also have different ways of working.

items.statement_ko: 조종사는 보통 혼자 일하고, 예술가는 보통 다른 사람들과 함께 일한다.
items.why_ko: 조종사가 다른 사람들과 일하고 예술가가 혼자 일한다고 했으므로 반대다.
_evidence_text: Pilots usually work with other people, but artists usually work alone.
items.statement_en: Pilots usually work alone, while artists usually work together with other people.
It is necessary for pilots to understand the people around them.

items.statement_ko: 예술가는 다른 사람들을 이해해야 한다고 했다.
items.why_ko: 예술가는 자기 자신을 이해해야 한다고 했다.
items.statement_en: According to the passage, artists have to understand other people.

items.statement_ko: 마지막으로 언급한 차이점은 생활 방식의 차이다.
items.why_ko: 13번 문장에 생활 방식의 중요한 차이라고 했다.
_evidence_text: Finally, there is an important difference in lifestyle.
items.statement_en: The last difference mentioned is a difference in the way they live.

items.statement_ko: 조종사는 일 때문에 여행을 하지만 집을 떠나 있는 일은 거의 없다.
items.why_ko: 조종사는 자주 집을 떠나 있다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Pilots travel for their job and are often away from home.
items.statement_en: Pilots travel because of their job, but they are almost never away from home.

items.statement_ko: 예술가는 집이나 집 근처의 작업실에서 일한다.
_evidence_text: Artists, however, work at home or in a studio near home.
items.statement_en: Artists do their work at home or in a studio close to their home.

items.statement_ko: 조종사도 예술가처럼 원할 때 일을 시작하고 멈출 수 있다.
items.why_ko: 조종사와 달리 예술가만 원할 때 일을 시작하고 멈출 수 있다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Also, unlike pilots, artists can start and stop working when they want.
items.statement_en: Like artists, pilots can also begin and stop their work whenever they want.

items.statement_ko: Jane은 비행기를 싫어해서 절대 조종사가 될 수 없다고 말했다.
_evidence_text: Maria said she could never be a pilot because she hates airplanes.
items.statement_en: Jane said she could never become a pilot because she hates airplanes.

items.statement_ko: Jane은 혼자 일하는 것을 싫어해서 예술가가 될 수 없다고 말했다.
_evidence_text: Jane said she could never be an artist because she hates working alone.
items.statement_en: Jane said she could never be an artist because she hates working by herself.

items.statement_ko: 직업을 고를 때 고려할 것이 많지만 자신이 즐기는 일이 가장 먼저라고 했다.
_evidence_text: There are many things to think about when choosing a job, but what you enjoy should come first.
items.statement_en: The passage says there is much to think about in choosing a job, but the thing you enjoy should come first.
